summary: The archive mailbox is operational on node1 and survives both node restarts. Node2 authenticates and retrieves both messages with their original Message-IDs, bodies, and read/unread state. The staged source remains intact.
actions_performed: Installed and enabled Alpine-compatible Dovecot 2.4.5 on node1.
Created the dedicated archive account with a node-generated demonstration password.
Copied the only source mailbox without modifying it; mapped one.eml to Seen and two.eml to unread.
Verified complete IMAP authentication and retrieval from node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Working IMAP service and dedicated archive credential
evidence.summary: Dovecot is running, archive authentication succeeds, and the dedicated credential files have restricted permissions.

evidence.requirement: Node2 retrieves both messages with preserved Message-IDs, bodies, and state
evidence.summary: IMAP transcripts show both original messages; one@branch.test is Seen and two@branch.test is unread.
Initial, imported, and final SHA-256 hashes match while all staged source files remain present.
Both nodes remained on Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered Dovecot/mailbox, and remote retrieval are proven.
Healthy client baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, persisted credential, and successful post-restart retrieval are proven.
